'''SAGRecreation''' was a section of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] that was responsible for creating wholesome activities to entertain its members. It was responsible for the creation of [[wegsphere]], a competitive sport whose popularity spread to thousands of [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Some branches of the division were filled with members who hoped to pursue a career in [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]]; they engaged in wargames and physical training as preparation for military training. Rumors abounded that some exercises were conducted with live [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] with the [[stunsafe]]s removed.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
